observations.why: Imperative directive issued as a settled instruction the speaker expects compliance with; no hedging or exploration. Decision-grade by its performed act.
Operational imperative with absolute scope ('all knowledge') — a settled, load-bearing instruction the speaker expects acted on, not a position under argument.
Flat unhedged assertion of fact, but no performed ratification or operational settling language — a claim the speaker would defend but is not enacting as a decision.
